the role of surgery for retroperitoneal sarcoma is limited.
the best treatment of choice for retroperitoneal sarcomas is surgical resection, with the aim to achieve complete resection of the tumour.

we do not routinely biopsy retroperitoneal sarcomas.

the presence of a large tumour in the retroperitoneum does not necessarily preclude the possibility of a curative resection.
